title: Ruapehu terrain visualised with satellite and radar data, 2002
credit: NASA Earth Observatory; Landsat processing Laura Rocchio; Shuttle Radar Topography Mission team / NASA/JPL/NIMA
altText: Oblique three-dimensional terrain visualisation of Mount Ruapehu with satellite-coloured topography.
caption: Perspective terrain image of Mount Ruapehu and Hauhungatahi made from Landsat satellite imagery and Shuttle Radar Topography Mission elevation data, 2002.
context: Illustrates genuine 3D elevation modelling; retain the existing chapter image as a separate asset and do not mistake this for a photograph from an aircraft.
